items.computation: Period is 14 days after the invoice date (Rechnungsdatum), 20.03.2026 (a Friday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (20.03.2026) is not counted; counting starts 21.03.2026. 14 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on 03.04.2026, a Friday. However 03.04.2026 is Karfreitag (Good Friday), a public holiday nationwide including NRW, so under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Tuesday 07.04.2026.
